BV1t7nh69EBF.ingredients: Minced pork, fish fillets, grated and shredded ginger, salt, sugar, cornstarch, soy sauce, water, cooked peanut oil and scallions. The fish species is unspecified.
BV1t7nh69EBF.quantities: Steam over high heat for 8 minutes. Half the seasoned pork is used here. Two fish were bought, but meat weights and patty thickness are unstated.
steps: Mix pork with grated ginger, a little water, salt, sugar, cornstarch and soy sauce.
Spread half the mixture thinly on a plate. Fillet and clean the fish, reserving the bones for soup, and arrange the flesh over the pork.
Add shredded ginger and a little cooked peanut oil. Steam over high heat for 8 minutes.
Scatter scallions over the cooked dish and serve with its juices.
BV1t7nh69EBF.missing: Fish species, weights, seasoning ratios, patty thickness and the timing start point are unspecified. Eight minutes describes this particular demonstration.

BV1t7nh69EBF.ingredients: Minced pork, grated ginger, water, salt, sugar, cornstarch and soy sauce. Additional frying oil is not clearly established.
BV1t7nh69EBF.quantities: The other half of the seasoned pork is used. No weight, heat setting or cooking time is given.
steps: Mix the pork with the same ginger, water, salt, sugar, cornstarch and soy sauce used for the steamed fish dish.
Put half in a frying pan and flatten it with paper placed between the meat and the pressing tool. Remove the shaping paper.
Brown and cook both sides, then divide into smaller pieces and plate.
BV1t7nh69EBF.missing: Paper material, temperature and cooking time are unstated. The paper is a shaping aid, not an ingredient to leave heating in the pan.

Season with salt and pepper and add scallions before serving.

BV12vnt6yEhA.ingredients: Salmon, potatoes, red and yellow sweet peppers, green pepper, shrimp, egg, lemon zest and juice, olive oil, black pepper salt and an unidentified dried herb.
BV12vnt6yEhA.quantities: Microwave potatoes without added water on high for 3 minutes. Air fry at 180°C for 15 minutes. One egg is fried; other weights and microwave wattage are unspecified.
steps: Scrub the potatoes, retain the skins and cut into pieces. Microwave without added water on high for 3 minutes, leaving them partly cooked.
Remove the sweet pepper seeds. Arrange peppers, potatoes and salmon on the tray, with the fish in a small dish. Air fry at 180°C for 15 minutes.
Separately pan fry the shrimp and egg until cooked.
Remove charred pepper skins and cut the peppers into pieces. Plate with potatoes, salmon, shrimp and egg.
Add lemon zest and juice, a little olive oil and black pepper salt. The video also adds a small amount of an unidentified dried herb.
BV12vnt6yEhA.missing: Fish weight, thickness, initial thawing state, microwave wattage and herb identity are unknown. The partly frozen fish shown does not establish that every thickness will cook through in 15 minutes.

Bring water to a boil, add the meat mixture in small portions and cook until set.
Add cleaned watercress, cook through and serve.
